name: POR(n)TALS
source:
You are alone. You were always alone. You lived with your parents but they were never really there - never truly a part of your life. When they went missing, you hardly felt anything.

Fortunately, you were taken in by a friend of your parents and moved into his house, where you now live with him and his two daughters. That's how you got a fresh start. New city, new home, new school, new people, new possibilities and new... worlds?

With appearing of the first portal, everything changed. 

Where do they lead? Why did this happen to you? What is their origin?

Experience many adventures together with your friends, strengthen your bonds and uncover the secrets hiding behind portals.

 And what will you do with it? That's up you!

[From [url=https://onehend.itch.io/porntals]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你孤身一人。你总是孤身一人。你和父母住在一起，但他们从来没有真正在那里——从来没有真正成为你生活的一部分。当他们失踪时，你几乎感觉不到任何东西。

幸运的是，你被你父母的一个朋友收留并搬进了他的房子，你现在和他以及他的两个女儿住在一起。就这样你有了一个新的开始。新的城市、新的家、新的学校、新的人、新的可能性和新的……世界？

随着第一个门户的出现，一切都改变了。

他们将通往何方？为什么这件事发生在你身上？他们的起源是什么？

与你的朋友一起经历许多冒险，加强你们的联系并揭开隐藏在门户背后的秘密。

 你会用它做什么？就你了！

[来自[url=https://onehend.itch.io/porntals]itch.io[/url]]
